quotient_index.image_observation: The full primary and witness images both show the denominator index i in the defining quotient and the later superscript i+1. The native congruence crop confirms the plus and the final 1.
quotient_index.exact_map: q_i:G^(i-1)->F^i=G^(i-1)/G^i is the defining quotient, with kernel G^i. Therefore q_i(a)=q_i(b) exactly when a-b belongs to G^i. The natural surjection G^(i-1)/G^(i+1)->F^i has kernel G^i/G^(i+1), which the printed congruence would fail to identify.
quotient_index.counterexample: Over a field k, take G^0=k^2, G^1=k e_1, G^2=0 and i=1. The elements e_2 and e_2+e_1 have the same nonzero image, hence the same basis, in F^1=k^2/k e_1. The upper-unipotent matrix [[1,1],[0,1]] sends e_2 to e_2+e_1. Their difference e_1 lies in G^1 and does not lie in G^2=0. Thus the printed i+1 congruence contradicts both the quotient definition and the equivalence modulo U used in the same sentence.
quotient_index.verdict: Accept the isolated current-only i+1 to i correction; retain i+1 diplomatically. This produces one English source variant.

torus_wording.image_observation: The full primary and witness images and the native crop all print the same phrase, with no word for the lines spanned by the basis vectors.
torus_wording.exact_maps: The diagonal subgroup morphism (G_m)^n -> GL_n sends (t_1,...,t_n) to diag(t_1,...,t_n). On an R-valued point it sends e_i to t_i e_i and consequently maps the line submodule R e_i to itself. The simultaneous pointwise stabilizer of all e_i is the subfunctor defined by t_i=1 for every i; more generally a matrix fixing every basis vector has every column equal to the corresponding identity column. That stabilizer is the identity group functor, whereas the diagonal torus preserves each basis line.
torus_wording.verdict: Retain the exact author phrase in both French forms and translate it literally in both English forms. The maps document the scope of the wording in decision records. They do not isolate a uniquely supported typesetting replacement. No English reader-apparatus entry is generated because there is no variant.
